emily: Heads-up — during a PagerDuty webhook audit I found a JSON payload that contains a Vault ciphertext field: `vault_cipher":"CiQA...` Header shows `projects/our-proj/locations/global/keyRings/vendor-kr/cryptoKeys/vendor-wrap/cryptoKeyVersions/3`. Looks like `secret/vendor/integration` but treat this as potential exfil. Shared artifact privately.

raj: Thanks. Any Decrypt calls in audit logs? Which principal used it?

emily: Quick log grep: `protoPayload.methodName=\"Decrypt\"` by `vendor-ws@vendor-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` at 2026-05-12T14:02:11Z. PagerDuty webhook event recorded at 14:07Z (so they likely pulled then forwarded).

mike: OK — immediate checklist: create an incident, temporarily deny that vendor SA on the wrapping key, snapshot KMS + Vault audit logs to the forensics BigQuery dataset, and enumerate Vault entries that reference `vendor-wrap`.

sec-bot: INC-2026-999 created: "Vendor webhook pasted KMS-wrapped Vault blob". Assigned to @emily, priority P2.

raj: Runbook sketch (staging-first):
```
# 1) create new key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --location=global --keyring=vendor-kr --key=vendor-wrap --project=our-proj
# 2) prefer server-side rewrap; fallback: ephemeral VM decrypt+encrypt (no disk, logging off)
# 3) enumerate vault keys metadata
vault kv list -format=json secret/vendor | xargs -I{} vault read -format=json secret/vendor/{} | jq .data.metadata
# 4) write rotated ciphertext back and tag meta.rotated_by=eng-security
```
I'll prepare hardened scripts for the ephemeral flow if we need it.

emily: I'll own vendor notification and legal loop. Scheduling a 45m maintenance window and will revoke the cross-project IAM binding temporarily. Also will rotate any integration tokens that can read `secret/vendor/*`.

mike: Add an alert: page eng-security on any Decrypt for `vendor-wrap` by principals outside `our-proj`. Keep old key version enabled for 10 minutes during cutover to allow retries, then remove access.

legal: Please include me on the vendor notification — may be contract-required disclosure.

emily: Noted. Updating thread as steps complete. :white_check_mark:
